title: Mac CLI: transcribe, install_mac, cross-platform transcribe hook, generate-from-image --prompt
paragraphs:
- Add POSIX transcribe (ffmpeg + faster-whisper) and deps.sh; install_mac links tools.
- Share runTranscribeForVideo: Windows uses C:\dev\tools\transcribe.bat when present, else transcribe on PATH.
- generate-from-image: --prompt/--variations/--aspect/--size non-interactive mode; open/folder use macOS open.
- video-to-markdown and video-description clipboard fixes; ghopen test harness stubs gh and clears GHOPEN_OPEN_COMMAND.
- img-upscale fast binary name on non-Windows; gitignore task-stats *_with_audio mux outputs.
- Document model tiers in transcribe README; AGENTS file tree includes tools/lib.

title: add video-description tool: Bun CLI for YouTube description generation from transcript, with clipboard copy, chat history, and context menu registration for videos and folders
